name: Menu input cost change review
summary: When supplier prices change, the chef and food-and-beverage manager get one worksheet: each price movement tied to the quantities in the supplied recipes, the cost per portion of every affected dish before and after, and questions for the chef. It sets no menu price.

sources.title: Fully Powered AI's own published map of hospitality work, and its own rules for prepared work: the kitchen's recipes, prices and costing rules as the only authority, set column headings with a stop on a mismatch, every gap written as a question for a named role, and a chef and manager who verify and decide.
